description: This file defines a `LocalSummarizer` class providing simple extractive text summarization functionalities, including extracting key sentences from a text, truncating content, and splitting into sentences.

classes.name: LocalSummarizer
classes.description: A simple local summarizer that extracts key sentences from text, used as a fallback when backend summarization is unavailable.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Generates a summary by extracting the first few sentences or truncating the content.

methods.name: _splitIntoSentences
methods.description: Splits input text into sentences based on punctuation delimiters.

methods.name: _truncate
methods.description: Truncates text to a maximum length, attempting to cut at word boundaries.
